@concat('SELECT 
    c.name AS classroom, 
    CONCAT(si.id, "-", se.school_inep_id_fk) AS `Special-id`, 
    se.school_inep_id_fk AS school_id, 
    t.month AS Month, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.day) AS "TotalScheduledDays", 
    SUM(IF(cf.faults > 0, 1, 0)) AS "AbsentDays", 
    COUNT(*) AS "TotalLessonPerDay", 
    SUM(cf.faults) AS "TotalFaults"
FROM `', item().DatabaseName, '`.schedule t
LEFT JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
LEFT JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
LEFT JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.student_enrollment se ON se.classroom_fk = t.classroom_fk
LEFT JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.student_identification si ON se.student_fk = si.id
LEFT JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.student_documents_and_address sd ON sd.id = si.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        schedule.classroom_fk, 
        schedule.month, 
        schedule.day, 
        student_fk, 
        COUNT(*) AS faults
    FROM `', item().DatabaseName, '`.class_faults cf
    LEFT JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.schedule ON schedule.id = schedule_fk
    GROUP BY student_fk, schedule.month, schedule.day, schedule.classroom_fk
) cf ON (c.id = cf.classroom_fk AND se.student_fk = cf.student_fk AND cf.month = t.month AND cf.day = t.day)
WHERE t.unavailable = 0 AND t.month = 1 and si.id is not null
GROUP BY 
    c.name, 
    `Special-id`, 
    se.school_inep_id_fk, 
    t.month
ORDER BY 
    t.month')

source.query:
@concat('SELECT 
    s.inep_id AS `school`, 
    c.name AS `classroom`, 
    CONCAT(si.id, "-", se.school_inep_id_fk) AS `student`, 
    ed.name AS `discipline_name`, 
    t.month AS `Month`, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.day) AS `TotalScheduledDays`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN (
        SELECT COUNT(1) 
        FROM `', item().DatabaseName, '`.class_faults cf 
        WHERE cf.schedule_fk = t.id AND cf.student_fk = si.id
    ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `AbsentDays`, 
    COUNT(1) AS `TotalLessonsPerDay`, 
    SUM(
        (SELECT COUNT(1) 
         FROM `', item().DatabaseName, '`.class_faults cf 
         WHERE cf.schedule_fk = t.id AND cf.student_fk = si.id)
    ) AS `TotalFaults`
FROM `', item().DatabaseName, '`.schedule t
JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.classroom c ON c.id = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.school_identification s ON s.inep_id = c.school_inep_fk
JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.edcenso_stage_vs_modality svm ON svm.id = c.edcenso_stage_vs_modality_fk
JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.student_enrollment se ON se.classroom_fk = t.classroom_fk
JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.student_identification si ON se.student_fk = si.id
JOIN `', item().DatabaseName, '`.edcenso_discipline ed ON t.discipline_fk = ed.id
WHERE t.unavailable = 0 
  AND c.school_year = 2024
  AND si.id is not null
  AND t.month = 1 
  AND (svm.unified_frequency = 0 OR svm.id NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 12, 13, 22, 23, 24, 41, 56, 83, 84))
GROUP BY 
    s.inep_id, 
    c.name, 
    si.id, 
    se.school_inep_id_fk, 
    ed.name, 
    t.month, 
    t.discipline_fk
ORDER BY 
    c.name, 
    si.id, 
    t.month')
